title: Boston Gas Company files a 275 Firm Day transportation Service Agreement with Deaconess Waltham Hospital located in Waltham, Massachusetts.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department approves the Company's proposed Agreement. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; James Connelly, W. Robert Keating and Paul B. Vasington, Commissioners.
